title: bouchea pseudochascanum
intro: Bouchea pseudochascanum, commonly known as Mexican tea or Hierba de la Santa Maria, is a plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and research has shown that it possesses several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Bouchea pseudochascanum include reducing fever, relieving respiratory issues, and soothing digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
